editorial:
Imagine you are watching a story about a sweet, hardworking girl from a poor family who thinks she has finally found true love. You get to follow Liza, who is totally smitten with a rich nobleman. He seems like a dream come true, treating her with kindness and promising her a future together. The movie feels like a classic romance at first, with a soft look and a slow build that makes you really root for the couple. You can tell right away that Liza is pure at heart, which makes the whole situation feel very risky from the start.

What really works here is how the acting makes you feel the heartbreak. The slow pace helps you feel the weight of the sadness as things fall apart. One downside is that it is a bit of a tear-jerker, so don't watch it if you are in a bad mood. If you enjoy emotional stories about love and betrayal, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want those crisp visuals for your movie night.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the nobleman reveals he was just playing a game. He leaves Liza completely broken and alone. In the final scenes, the pain becomes too much for her to handle. She decides to end her own life because she cannot imagine a world without the love she thought she had. It is a sad ending that shows how cruel people in power can be to those who trust them blindly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic tragic romances and emotional dramas.
